headline: African Startups Face Higher Funding Bar Amid Investor Focus
summary: African startups are encountering a more demanding fundraising environment as investors increasingly prioritize profitability, proven traction, and efficient capital use over rapid expansion.
why: Venture capital conditions in developing markets reflect broader global risk sentiment and shifts toward capital efficiency and sustainable business models.

impacts.name: African Startups
impacts.why: A tougher fundraising climate alters capital access for regional technology companies.
